title: Event missing metadata — no event_id, timestamp, or source for debugging
expected_feedback: Standard: the event carries no identity or type metadata. event_id is the load-bearing omission — without it consumers have no dedup key, and at-least-once delivery makes deduplication mandatory unless every consumer operation is provably idempotent. event_type matters on a multi-type topic for routing without deserialising. timestamp, source and correlation_id are strong defaults; prefer carrying trace context in Kafka record headers so it is readable without deserialisation. schema_version is redundant when Schema Registry is in use — the wire format already carries the schema ID — so add it only for raw-JSON topics.
checklist_anchor: Event carries the metadata its consumers actually need
